name: game_main_thread_proc
notes: game init calls then loop on game_frame_tick (00)

name: game_frame_tick

name: packfile_find_mounted

name: file_close

name: packfile_mount_temp

name: packfile_header_install

name: file_read_sector_aligned

name: packfile_fixup_and_register

name: packfile_compute_entry_sectors

name: packfile_find_in_temp

name: smesh_cache_release_chunk
notes: AX = chunk id, stack object template: drops that chunk reference; with none left and not loaded (+0x122), unloads the mesh/peg objects (+0x10C), clears the record and returns it to its pool (05)

name: smesh_cache_free

name: smesh_cache_record_add_chunk
notes: EDI = record, stack chunk id -> bool: already present, or stored in a free +0x116 slot; false if all six are taken (05)

name: smesh_cache_filter_requests

name: smesh_cache_record_clear

name: streamman_release_chunk_extras

name: streamman_submit_single_read

Used only by process_sequential (05)

name: chunk_pool_index

name: read_cache_lookup
notes: ESI = request+4 (the 8-dword description): under CS 0x2F9B1E4, if a read cache is set (0x2529E34) finds an entry by name (read_cache_find) and memcpys it to the destination; true = served, the file is not opened. Called by hdd_service before file_open (05)

name: read_cache_store
notes: EAX = request+4: after a read, if the cache accepts the name (read_cache_accepts) copies the data into it (read_cache_add). Called by hdd_service (05)

name: read_cache_add
notes: ESI = request+4: unless already cached, and while the cache has < 0x20 entries (+0x1A4), allocs name and data from the allocator 0x2529E2C (vtable +0x18 can_alloc, +0x1C alloc) and appends {name, data, size} at cache+0x28 + i*0xC (05)

name: read_cache_find
notes: (request+4) -> cache entry whose name (with suffix applied via path_change_extension) matches by stricmp, or 0 (05)

name: read_cache_accepts
notes: (cache, name) -> bool: strnicmp against the cache name prefixes (05)

name: rsched_init
notes: resource slot scheduler: stack (sched, cfg+0, cfg+4, cfg+8, cfg+0xC, cfg+0x14 request count, u8 cfg+0x1C), ECX = slot count (cfg+0x10), EAX = group count (cfg+0x18). Allocs slots (0x3C), requests (0x48, each with a per-group count array), per-group request queues at +0x40 (sized by the request count, compare rsched_request_compare) and slot queues at +0x44 (sized by the slot count, compare rsched_slot_compare), quotas; then rsched_reset (05)

name: rsched_reset
notes: EDI = sched: clears lists and flags, every slot to the free list (state 4) and pushed on its queue, every request to the free request list (05)

name: rsched_update
notes: EAX = sched: when dirty (+0xD0 bit 1) and not disabled (bit 0): binds unbound requests to loaded slots, rebalances group quotas (rsched_assign_group_quotas), runs rsched_update_group per group, then applies the releases deferred while updating (+0x48 count, 0x10-byte records at +0x4C) (05)

name: rsched_add_ref
notes: EAX = sched, stack (id, level 0..6, group, bool load_now): finds the request for id or takes a free one, bumps its level and group counts, re-queues it if its best level or group changed; marks the scheduler dirty (05)

name: rsched_release
notes: EAX = sched, EDX = id, stack (level, group, bool all): deferred while updating (bit 3). Drops the counts (or all of them); with none left, unbinds the slot (making it idle) and returns the request to the free list (05)

name: rsched_assign_group_quotas
notes: (sched): pops each group slot queue and moves slots between groups so each group has its quota (+0xCC[group]); a slot moved off a group is unbound from its request (05)

name: rsched_update_group
notes: EAX = group, stack (sched): pairs the best requests (request queue) with the worst slots (slot queue): requests already resident or flagged in the registry are skipped; a slot with a lower-or-equal request is evicted (rsched_slot_evict) and reassigned, state 1, and if the request has load_now a job is queued (rsched_job_add with the slot buffers: cfg+0 + i*cfg+4 and cfg+8 + i*cfg+0xC) (05)

name: rsched_bind_loaded_slot
notes: EDI = sched, stack (request): finds a slot holding the same id that is not free (state != 4) and binds them; updates the slot group (05)

name: rsched_slot_make_idle
notes: EAX = slot, ECX = sched: moves the slot from the in-use list (+0x18) to the idle-loaded list (+0xC), state 0, unbinds the request and calls the kind available callback 0x22248FC[kind*4] (cfg+0x24) with the id (05)

name: rsched_slot_evict
notes: ESI = slot, stack (sched): unbinds, removes it from its list by state (0 idle +0xC, 1 queued +0x10 and cancels its job, 4 free +0x1C); for a loaded (state 0) slot calls the unload callback 0x2224904[kind*4] (cfg+0x2C) (05)

name: rsched_request_compare
notes: request queue compare (a, b) -> 0/1/2: requests with flag +0x18 bit 0 first, then rsched_compare_failed on the ids, then the higher best level (+0x2C..+0x44), then bound before unbound, then the bound slot time (+0x14), then slot +0x10 (05)

name: rsched_slot_compare
notes: slot queue compare (a, b) -> 0/1/2: rsched_compare_failed on the ids, then the bound request best level (unbound counts as 2), then time (+0x14), then +0x10, ties by 0xA78E30 (05)

name: rsched_job_add
notes: cdecl (id, dest, size, dest2, size2, level) -> job queue index, or -1 if 50 jobs are queued (0x2529E4C). Jobs are 0x20 bytes: free list 0x2529E54, active 0x2529E50, queue 0x2F9B2D0 (05)

name: rsched_job_cancel
notes: removes a queued job from the queue 0x2F9B2D0 and returns it to the free list (05)

name: rsched_job_start_next
notes: pops the best job (0x2F9B2D0), makes it current (0x2529E58) and requests it by kind (id >> 24): 0/2/3 character (0xA78030), 1/5 vehicle (0xA785F0), 4 animation (streamman_request_animation with the registry name, "Empty" for -1). The handle goes to 0xEB80F8 (05)

name: rsched_job_pump
notes: if a job is current (handle 0xEB80F8) and its slot is idle: loaded (state 4) -> 0xA78950(job, slot+8), else 0xA789B0(job); clears the slot, frees the job; then rsched_job_start_next (05)

name: rsched_job_request_character
notes: kinds 0/2/3: builds the file names from the registry entry (.morph_pc/.pcm_pc/.sim_pc/.cvtf, "Empty") and calls streamman_request_character (05)

name: rsched_job_request_vehicle

name: streamman_request_vehicle

Replaced by Rust (streamman.rs, PUMP_RUST; register entry thunk): 34 requests per teleport run (ambient, differ between runs).
